newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kia Group mulls selling Asia Motors.
newsitem.headline: Kia Group mulls selling Asia Motors.

text.p: South Korea's troubled Kia Group is considering selling its commercial vehicle maker Asia Motors Co Ltd and its sales affiliate Asia Motor Sales Co, a group spokesman said on Thursday.
However, he said it was undecided when the final decision would be made.
But a source close to Kia Group said a decision to sell was "inevitable" because of pressure by creditor banks.

Kia has previously said it would slim down by reducing the number of domestic affiliates to 13 from the current 28. If Kia decides to sell the additional two units, its affiliates would further be cut to 11.
Creditor banks last week selected 18 Kia affiliates for protection after determining the group would be unable to avoid defaulting on its debt payments.
